# ship-space

Your interface to the `space` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`space.active`](references/docs/space.active.mdoc) — The active space, if one has been activated.
- [`space.info`](references/docs/space.info.mdoc) — The active space's identity and effective (global→space) config.
- [`space.list`](references/docs/space.list.mdoc) — List the registered spaces (each a .ship/ directory).
- [`space.watch`](references/docs/space.watch.mdoc) — Live watch — the space registry (list + active) or one space's settings.

## Commands

- [`space.activate`](references/docs/space.activate.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Switch the daemon's active space.
- [`space.add`](references/docs/space.add.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Register a directory as a space (ensures its .ship/ exists).
- [`space.set_setting`](references/docs/space.set_setting.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Set a per-space settings override (value is arbitrary JSON).
